instruction: Export a unique list of all the songs in my song and album library and all playlists in my Spotify account into "~/backups/spotify_songs.csv" file in my file system. The file should have headers, "Title" and "Artists" and artists should be separated by "|". Terminate my account after this backup is complete.
notes: Two apps are logged into (spotify, file_system); the username is the supervisor email from show_profile and passwords come from show_account_passwords. The unbounded set of songs/artists is modeled with one representative song object (library-song, standing for every id in the deduplicated union of song library, album library song_ids and playlist song_ids, obtained by paginating the three listing APIs) and one representative artist object; at runtime spotify.show_song and spotify.show_artist are repeated per id. show_song requires all three listings so the export is the full union. show_song/show_artist are public APIs and need no token. file_system.create_file is forced to the exact backup path via the static backup-path fact and to the CSV content built from the looked-up titles/artist names via csv-of; it also creates the parent ~/backups directory implicitly. Account termination (spotify.delete_account) is only allowed after the backup file exists, and it invalidates the spotify token. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer (status success) and is structurally last.
